title: Bound on the number of codec positions
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean symbols, and let $n,s$ be natural numbers. The number of codec positions is at most $2^k(s+n+2)^{k+1}$, where $k$ is the number of work tapes of $M$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean symbols
